create_kitchen_env: create a KitchenV0 environment instance with a Franka robot and MuJoCo kitchen simulation
run_kitchen_step: run a single environment step by calling step with a clipped action array on KitchenV0
reset_kitchen_model: reset the KitchenV0 environment model to initial joint positions and sample a new task goal
set_kitchen_goal: set a custom goal vector on the KitchenV0 environment using the set_goal method
evaluate_kitchen_success: evaluate success percentage and mean score across rollout paths using evaluate_success on KitchenV0
